findings.finding: The diff removes the `git diff --quiet HEAD -- shipwright_events.jsonl ||` guard. record_event.py can exit 0 without writing (append_event_idempotent dedups phase_completed and returns skipped), so `git commit` fails with nothing to commit (exit 1) and `git push origin HEAD` never runs; after a partial run (event committed, push failed) every re-run stops at the commit and never retries the push. The same applies to the on-main block.
findings.suggestion: Keep && fail-fast but make the commit conditional: `... && git add shipwright_events.jsonl && { git diff --cached --quiet -- shipwright_events.jsonl || git commit -m "..." -- shipwright_events.jsonl; } && git push origin HEAD`; same group in the on-main block.

findings.finding: The stub record_event always appends, so the recorded-nothing exit-0 path and the push-retry after a partial run are never exercised; a block that fails on a no-op passes the whole suite.
findings.suggestion: Add a STUB_NOOP mode (exit 0, no write) and tests over both blocks asserting exit 0, HEAD unchanged and, for the PR flow, remote branch equal to HEAD; add a re-run test where the first push did not land.

findings.finding: In the on-main parametrisation of the failing-record_event test the remote assertion proves nothing (no push in that block) and the test checks out release/v1.2.3, so it does not run on main.
findings.suggestion: Stay on main for the on-main case and assert no staged change and remote main unchanged, or drop the remote assertion for that case.

findings.finding: `git add shipwright_events.jsonl` fails when a target project gitignores the events file; the old guard silently skipped the commit there.
findings.suggestion: Document that the file must be tracked, or skip add/commit when `git check-ignore -q` matches, still pushing.

findings.finding: On Windows shutil.which('bash') can resolve to the WSL launcher in System32 where the stub uv shebang and C:/ paths fail; loud failure, confusing cause.
findings.suggestion: Prefer Git-for-Windows bash or skip when the resolved path is under System32.

doubt.disposition: small prose+test diff; doubt pass is conditional (no migration/concurrency/cross-plugin/irreversible op); code-reviewer findings (guarded commit, no-op retry, on-main test) were fixed and mutation-checked
